IS 3642 : Part 1 : 1990 Surgical instruments - Part 1: Non-cutting articulated instrumentsUDC 615.471 : 620.1MHD 1Reaffirmed 20161 Scope1.1 This standard specifies the requirements for a general rangeof non-cutting, articulated instruments used in surgery.1.1.1 The general range of instruments shall cover arteryforceps, dissecting forceps, tissue forceps, needle holders, clampsand other instruments of similar design. It shall, however, notinclude special purpose, non-cutting articulated instruments suchas midwifery forceps, nasal forceps, peritonsillar forceps, eyeneedle holders barraquers pattern, etc.2 ReferencesIS 1501 : Part 1 :1984Method for Vickers hardness test formetallicmaterials: Part 1 HV 5 to HV 100IS 4218:ISO metric screw threadsIS 4905 :1968Methods for random samplingIS 6528 :1972Stainless steel wireIS 6603 :1972Stainless steel bars and flatsIS 6911 :1972Stainless steel plate, sheet and stripIS 7531 :1991Method of testing for corrosion resistance ofstainless steel surgical instruments
